title: Final CVKI Research v2.x Benchmark & Scientific Evaluation
verdict_reason: The repository supports narrow internal CV observations on small D1 splits and controlled synthetic R5/R6 perturbations. D2 is unavailable; R8 admitted zero legitimate civic cases; R9 has no empirical evaluation. Independent source provenance for D1 is unresolved. The full research record does not validate multimodal or broad real-world civic performance.
major_limitations: D1 is a 122-image research candidate; source/license/real-vs-simulated lineage remains unreconciled.
R3 held-out test contains 18 images and 15 positive boxes, all road_waterlogging; no class-0 or class-1 test boxes.
D2 and independent cross-dataset evaluation are unavailable.
R5 uses controlled synthetic transforms of 18 D1 test images, not external weather or domain evidence.
R6 uses synthetic sequences from D1 still images; real-world video is unavailable.
R7/R8 have zero eligible civic cases; R9 is protocol-only.
Geographic and authority fields in D1 are not independently verified; no multimodal responsibility evaluation exists.
Local CPU timing is not a field-real-time guarantee.

regression_summary.command_scope: R0-R10 research regression (including R2.1) plus relevant M8-M12 suites
